'''Operation Joystick''' was a mission carried out by the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] to bring the planet [[Adumar/Legends|Adumar]] and its military resources into Republic membership.<ref name="TCSWE">{{CSWECite|II|416|Operation Joystick}}</ref>

Prior to the arrival of [[Red Flight]] on Adumar, [[New Republic Intelligence Service]] sent [[Tomer Darpen/Legends|Tomer Darpen]], under the codename NRI1, to investigate and survey the local culture. Darpen gave a detailed report about the planet's lack of planetary government and their different customs. It was also when he requested for famous [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] to be sent as ambassadors while he remained on the world for further preparations.<ref name="APW">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/sw20040401adumarmain|text=Adumar: Pilots Wanted|int=Adumar: Pilots Wanted}}</ref>
